simpler.evidence: design D2 weighs the two simpler alternatives: `agent-process / quality` in REQUIRED_CONTEXTS (rejected: the classic-only guard would report drift on every push) and a live rules read in review_gate (rejected: remote read plus parser in a script issue 115 deletes).
